description: Canonical seed registry for platform tools. Mirrors config/platform_mcp_tools.json without changing runtime loading.

tools.name: workspace_file_router
tools.description: Read/write a repo-relative file path inside the active target repository.
approval_requirements: Repository path constraints enforced before writes

tools.name: execute_isolated_task
tools.description: Execute a short Python snippet inside a best-effort sandbox prelude.
approval_requirements: Read-only and no-network restrictions may be enforced by profile

tools.name: network_data_fetch
approval_requirements: Future human approval policy expected before broad network use

tools.name: graphics_validate_transform_math
tools.description: Validate 3D transforms and bounding boxes for non-finite values and divide-by-zero risk.

tools.name: graphics_parse_matrix4
tools.description: Parse a 4x4 matrix into 16 finite floats.

tools.name: trace_asset_compilation
tools.description: Run a repo-pinned local asset compilation command without shell operators and return structured traces.
approval_requirements: Repo boundary enforced for asset and repo-local script paths
Failed traces may be sent to the twin for feedback
